data.body:
[P2] Preserve non-retryable control failures through cleanup

If a processor raises `SystemExit` or `KeyboardInterrupt` during a virtual child's normal terminal hook, this branch re-raises while leaving the completion pending. Core then invokes invocation End during exception cleanup. Its fresh `InvocationFinalization` has no record of the control failure, so it recreates the span and calls the processor again, potentially repeating partial delivery despite the control signal. Invocation view has the same path. Track non-retryable failures for the whole invocation and exclude them from subsequent drains; add a public virtual-child regression asserting one processor attempt and propagation of the original exception.
